main_text.l: CUm omnes illi præclare de re Chris-
atque ita quasi gentium spolia ad ornatum regni Christi
congerunt: tum haud scio an ulli melius, quam qui linguæ
& Juris Hebræorum periti, inde, ceu ex pro-
pria sede, historiæ & phrasi Novi Testamenti lucem
fœnerantur. Habet multum Græcia, habet & illa quondam
gentium domina Roma multum, quo neglecto,
vel non satis dextrè percepto frustra Novum Testamen-
tum intelligere labores: quantumcunque tamen illud
est, quod sane magnum est, est כמו טיפה מן
הים/ seu ludum jocumque dicas præ iis, quæ Hebræorum A mo-

page.notes: Hebrew phrase "כמו טיפה מן הים" transcribed as printed (rendered approximately, "as a drop from the sea"). Woodcut initial C of "CUm" is decorative. The line "quod sane magnum est" is followed by the Hebrew inline. Title block lines set in large capitals and italics; the heading levels are assigned by the editor.
